import test from "node:test"
import assert from "node:assert/strict"
import { put, get } from "../src/cache.mjs"

test("缓存按租户隔离", () => {
  put({ tenant: "a", id: 1 }, "A")
  put({ tenant: "b", id: 1 }, "B")
  assert.equal(get({ tenant: "a", id: 1 }), "A")
  assert.equal(get({ tenant: "b", id: 1 }), "B")
})
